## Behaviour
Reference `set` updates title, body (non-empty, from file), priority, kind, labels (add/remove) and parent (including removing it) and verifies the result. In qew: refuse any set on a completed or closed item unless `--closed` (exit 2, names the flag); add `--body-file`, `--add-label`/`--remove-label` (today `--labels` replaces the set), `--no-parent`, `--kind`; refuse reserved label namespaces (see `create-reserved-labels`); refuse an empty or multi-line title and an empty body replacement; re-read the item after the write and fail loudly if the header differs (partial write). Each change appends a `field` event with old and new (covered). Applying the same values again prints `unchanged`.

## Scenarios
- golden: change title, body from file, priority, kind, add and remove a label, new parent in one command; header and one field event per change (prevents: edits that are not audited)
- completed or closed target without `--closed`: exit 2, file untouched (prevents: stale edits to finished work)
- empty title, multi-line title, empty body file, symlinked body file: exit 2 (prevents: corrupting the fixed header format)
- `--no-parent` removes the parent; repeating any set is `unchanged` (prevents: noisy audit trail)

## Reference coverage
2 reference test function(s): `test_set_golden_walk_updates_fields_and_verifies_result`, `test_set_refusal_walk_rejects_closed_target_without_override`

## Qew today
Reduced. Covered: title, priority and field audit events (ledger walk test_set_changes_the_header_and_records_an_audit_event). Missing: body-file, add/remove label, no-parent, kind, terminal-state guard, input validation.
seen.title: Extend `qew set` with safe field edits and a terminal-state guard
